items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I played with Paul Barbraham, made an album with him.

ctx.x: Well sure that's right, that's when Sheik was talking about that same group.

Yeah, my own band out there and everything was real nice. Yeah, I forgot about the name, I forgot the name of it. Before I went out there with him, well I played around here with different bands. I played with Paul Barbraham, made an album with him. Yeah, I remember that. Good time jazz. I remember some time back I played a couple of jobs with Pap Celestine before he died. Well and as a rule as New Orleans musicians do, they're always playing from one to the
other. That's right, that's always been there.
